topic: Data API upload to S3 setup
summary_markdown:
The discussion concerns setting up a data API upload process to S3. [me] stated that the necessary shell scripts are in the repository, although they are written for a different Bash dialect. Keys were sent via email, and a ticket will be created.
[p1] requested clarification on the source of the data and the required format before proceeding with the setup.
decisions: The data API upload to S3 needs to be implemented using existing shell scripts.
action_items: Someone needs to create a ticket for the implementation.
Clarification is needed regarding the data source and required upload format.
